ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with high-intensity (white) pixels constituting approximately 15% of the visible area, primarily as scattered punctate clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottling composed of irregular high-contrast blobs (1-10 pixel diameter) distributed across both lobes. Density is highest on the left lobe's lower medial region and along the trailing margins of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged continuous boundary featuring high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) of 5-15 pixels in depth across the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending laterally from the median notch, terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scar patterns, concentrated in the lower medial sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the right lobe surface, oriented diagonally toward the outer tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural irregularity on the trailing edge of both lobes, suggesting previous physical tissue loss or high-impact interactions.
